what: The 1 090 pictures of this test, each pinned by its sha256: 500 photos and 500 documents that KELVIN lives (in this order), 24 of them asked again (asked_again), 30 + 30 unseen photos and documents, and 30 screens of a kind it never lived. Nothing of them is stored in this repository; run.py fetches each one from its source and refuses any file that does not match.

photo.name: COCO 2017, train split
photo.how: each photo from its own url at images.cocodataset.org (plain http: that host's https certificate does not name it; the sha256 is checked either way)
photo.licences: only photos under licence id 4 (Attribution, CC BY 2.0) or 5 (Attribution-ShareAlike, CC BY-SA 2.0), per photo as COCO's instances_train2017.json states it
photo.authors: COCO records each photo's Flickr address, not its author's name; flickr_page is the photo's page on Flickr, as COCO records it
photo.terms: The COCO Consortium does not own the images; their use must abide by the Flickr Terms of Use (cocodataset.org/#termsofuse).

document.name: DocLayNet v1.1, val split
document.how: each page by its row (offset) through the Hugging Face dataset viewer's rows service, which serves the page as a JPEG; those are the bytes pinned here

screen.name: WebSight v0.1 (rendered web pages)
screen.how: each screen by its row (offset) through the Hugging Face dataset viewer's rows service, as a PNG
